summary: Collapse the hand-back frame in the preview

message.content:
Here is what a subagent hand-back looks like in the raw transcript today:

```
Another Claude session sent a message:
<agent-message from="abc">
[Subagent hand-back] The text below is the final report of a subagent this
session delegated to. The report follows:
  Line one of the quoted report.
  Line two of the quoted report.
</agent-message>
```

Can the preview collapse that to a single line?

content.text: Only when the record carries a structural `origin` — the frame text alone never decides.
